summary: Tested backend endpoints /api/consulta-cnpj/{cnpj} and /api/identificacao plus full frontend iframe flow for PGMEI clone. All backend tests passed (5/5). Frontend valid-flow navigates to /pgmei2.html with correctly masked CNPJ 37.411.286/0001-08 and real name 'LUCI SCHIAVI DA SILVA 42017335215' fetched from BrasilAPI. Invalid CNPJ shows red banner (#pgmei-banner.show.err) and does NOT navigate.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER consulta_cnpj uses it in the except block. If a BrasilAPI exception occurs before logger initialization (unlikely at runtime since init runs at import), it could NameError. Low priority - move logger config above routes.
pgmei.html/pgmei2.html are huge single-file dumps (SingleFile); fine for study clone but hard to maintain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BrasilAPI is live and returned expected real names. test_cnpj.py covers both valid CNPJs, invalid fallback, and identificacao endpoint.
